label: rem:lepton-discrepancies
title: Electron--muon discrepancies
html:
Remark. Electron--muon discrepancies

Two structural criteria distinguish lepton generations. These are Reeb-vertical degree of knot localisation (rem:archimedean-leptons), and whether the cyclic symmetry embeds in S_5 (rem:symmetry-preserving-leptons). The electron and muon satisfy both. The tau satisfies only the first. Anomalous magnetic-moment tensions and lepton flavour universality violations observed at B-factories may reflect this structural asymmetry rather than new heavy-particle loops. This is likely where the discrepancy tracks specifically with the tau channel.
